(1) Any person who within an Area declared in terms

column1: of section 26, prevents or acts in such a manner as to prevent
any other person from enjoying the facilities available within
such Area or does any act which interferes  with the privacy
of any other person, or contravenes any regulation made under
paragraphs (a) and (b) of subsection (3) of section 27 shall be
guilty  of  an  offence  and  shall  on  conviction  after  trial  be
liable to a fine not less than rupees twenty five thousand and
not exceeding one hundred thousand.

column2: (2) For the purposes of this Part “privacy” shall include

column1: the right of any person to be left alone in his enjoyment of
the    environment,  and  the  facilities  and  services  available
within any area declared as a Tourist Development Area in
terms  of  section  26,  without  any  intrusion  into  his  private
life,  which  intrusion  could  be  considered  offensive  to  a
reasonable person.
